main_body: Large brick institutional building: a flat green roof with a light stone parapet seen from above, over a three-storey brick facade with a cream cornice, rows of windows and an arched green double door
top_band: Green roof surface with a light lilac-grey parapet, rows 1-38 at x=80 (parapet L~226/158 rows 1-5, green L~115 rows 8-37, light front edge rows 39-41), lighter than the brick face below
evidence: Reading column x=80 downward: parapet outline, then a green roof plane of about 31 rows with tile lines, a chimney and a skylight. A light parapet edge (rows 39-41) and a cream cornice (rows 42-46) follow, then a dark shadow row at 47, then the brick front face with windows. The roof is a clearly visible horizontal surface, so the drawing is not a bare front elevation. Windows have sills, lintels and dark inner frames, so they read as inset. The roof is deep for a 3/4 view, but the structure still matches the contract: top band, front edge, eave shadow, front face.

style.evidence: The brick has about 4-5 tones with mortar lines and per-brick variation. The roof greens carry 4 tones with speckle and tile lines. The cream trim, window glass and stone parapet each have several steps. Dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outlines are tinted (dark brown beside brick, dark green beside the roof). Flat-fill coverage is 0%. The median of 13 colours per tile sits between the two references (18 and 11). The 42 distinct colours are lower than the references (66 and 185), but the palette is locked per theme and the tiles stay information-rich. It would sit acceptably next to the references.
